items.question: Is Magic Resume free to use?
items.answer: Magic Resume is currently free, meeting basic resume creation needs. The open-source version's features will remain unchanged

items.question: Is my resume data secure?
items.answer: Yes, very secure. Magic Resume uses local storage, meaning all your data is stored on your own device with no cloud storage, ensuring complete privacy protection.

items.question: What export formats are supported?
items.answer: We currently support PDF export, ensuring your resume maintains consistent formatting on any device. We plan to support more export formats in the future.

items.question: How can I sync across devices?
items.answer: We provide JSON configuration export, allowing you to save your resume settings in JSON format, accessible anytime, anywhere, on any device.

items.question: How customizable is it?
items.answer: We offer rich customization options, including colors, layouts, and more, allowing you to adjust your resume style according to personal preferences and industry requirements.

browser-compatibility.question: Which browser is recommended?
browser-compatibility.answer: We recommend using the latest version of Chrome or Edge for the best layout and export experience. Some outdated browsers may cause styling issues.

export-failure.question: What if export fails or style is broken?
export-failure.answer:
1. We recommend using Google Chrome (https://www.google.cn/intl/zh-CN/chrome/) for best compatibility.
2. If it still fails, try in 'Incognito Mode' to exclude extension interference.
3. Alternatively, click 'PDF (Backup)' in the export menu and select 'Save as PDF' in the print dialog.

export-methods.question: What's the difference between the two export methods?
export-methods.answer:
• Export PDF: Uses a backend service for high-precision rendering, 100% restoring the layout. Recommended for formal submission to HR.

• Browser Print: Invokes your current browser's native print function (Save as PDF). Suitable when the backend export service is busy or you need to fine-tune print margins via your browser.

drag-and-drop.question: How do I drag and drop to reorder modules?
drag-and-drop.answer: In the 'Layout' settings of the left edit panel, hover your cursor over the 'Drag Handle' (usually represented by a six-dot icon) on the left side of the module card. Click and hold the left mouse button to drag the module up or down to reorder the sections of your entire resume.
